description_for_human: Lock XRP or RLUSD in crypto-condition escrow, submit proof of work, and receive automatic payment on AI-verified PASS. Supports NFT, domain, W3C VC proof gates and dual-model consensus audit. MCP at https://mcp.cryptovault.co.uk/mcp.
description_for_model: Trust-minimized escrow for agent-to-agent work on the XRP Ledger. Flow: buyer calls /escrow/generate to lock funds → seller submits proof to /evaluate → AI referee audits against criteria → PASS auto-releases XRP/RLUSD to seller. Proof gates (NFT ownership, XRPL domain, W3C VC, NFT DvP) can gate release before AI audit. Set require_consensus_vault=true for dual-model audit (Gemini Flash + Pro, $0.25 one-time vault fee). INCONCLUSIVE does not consume an attempt for the first 3 per vault; later ones count. Implements x402: call any paid endpoint without payment to receive 402 with X-Payment-Required describing how to pay. MCP server at https://mcp.cryptovault.co.uk/mcp.
